name: MMA Legends🥊
desc:
🥊 MMA Legends is a 1v1 Martial Arts fighting game.

BETA RELEASE, BUGS SHOULD BE EXPECTED!

📜 Use Code “24KLIKES" 

🔥 Choose your fighting style, each with unique moves and abilities inspired by real and anime martial arts legends. Step into the cage, unleash devastating combos, and prove you're the ultimate martial arts champion. Will you rise to the top?

Controls/Tips: 
• M1 = Light Attack
• M2 = Heavy Attack
• Hold F = Block
• Space = Dodge
• Press M1/M2 + Shift quickly to feint 

Tags: Boxing, Karate, Wrestle, Fighting, 1v1, duel, knockout
